decisions.reason: Four years after launch with no negative results, uncertainty has declined enough to keep this open option at low cost while it serves a specialized application.
As a core automatic gun now established, its demand uncertainty has largely resolved, justifying a low probability of being dropped.
The manual gun remains a viable mature option with no negative signals, so the firm keeps it open at relatively low cost.
A product line with several models provides broader optionality and no negative signals after four years, so the line is kept with very low probability of being dropped.
